name: 36_diagonal_huygens_array_3d
energy_note: Staggered-field proxy; includes PML and is not an exact discrete invariant or calibrated joules.
detector_note: Mean sum of squared staggered electric components; not calibrated Poynting flux or antenna gain.
notes: Source-only prototype: no refraction interface is active in refraccionlarry.m. Added z depth is 64 cells, dz=dx, with 12-cell z PML. The x-y geometry, grid spacing and time-step count are preserved. Twenty equal-phase z-directed dipoles along the original diagonal at the center z plane.
